products.name: Red Velvet Cake
products.summary: Three soft cocoa layers with whipped cream cheese frosting.
products.description:
Our best seller. Three layers of moist red velvet sponge with a hint of cocoa, filled and topped with tangy cream cheese frosting and red velvet crumbs.

Serves 10 to 12. Order at least 24 hours ahead.

image.alt: Red velvet cake with a slice cut out, topped with cream rosettes

products.name: Chocolate Orange Cake
products.summary: Dark chocolate mousse cake with a mirror glaze and candied orange.
products.description:
Rich dark chocolate mousse on a crunchy biscuit base, finished with a shiny mirror glaze and slices of candied orange.

Serves 8 to 10. Keep refrigerated.

image.alt: Glossy chocolate cake topped with candied orange slices

products.name: Strawberry Cream Cake
products.summary: Vanilla sponge loaded with fresh strawberries and whipped cream.
products.description:
Light vanilla sponge layered with fresh cream and covered with glazed strawberries and raspberries.

Serves 10. Available while strawberries are in season.

image.alt: Cake covered in glazed strawberries with piped cream around the edge

products.name: Party Cupcake Box
products.summary: Twelve assorted cupcakes for birthdays and dessert tables.
products.description:
A box of twelve cupcakes in vanilla, chocolate and strawberry, each finished with buttercream and sprinkles.

Perfect for dessert tables. Custom colours available on request.

image.alt: Dessert table with cupcakes on a tiered stand

products.name: Strawberry Tart
products.summary: Crisp pastry with vanilla custard, strawberries and fresh mint.
products.description:
Flaky pastry filled with vanilla custard and topped with fresh strawberries, strawberry glaze and mint leaves.

Serves 6. Best enjoyed on the day.

image.alt: Round tart topped with glazed strawberries and mint leaves
